name: ai-github-project-analyzer
description: AI-Powered GitHub Project Analyzer & Architecture Reviewer

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
